snippet.title: Lord of Mysteries - Official Reveal Trailer | "Praise The Fool"
snippet.description:
Around the ancient temple, a gray fog swirls.
Over a bronze table, the coin of destiny is tossed.

Klein emerges from the enigma, and his eyes unveil this world.
------------------------------------------------------------- 
This is a song dedicated to Mr. Fool.

Performers: Cai Chengyu, Shanghai Music Art Development Center for Collaborative Innovation
Composition & Arrangement: litterzy
Chinese Lyrics: Universe
Constructed Language Design: DAJIU
-------------------------------------------------------------
The game adaptation of "Lord of Mysteries," written by Cuttlefish That Loves Diving, is currently in fervent development. 
Developer: SPARK NEXA
-------------------------------------------------------------
Praise the Fool!
#LordofMysteriesGame #LordofMysteries #LOM
